data.one_liner: A pre-built checkout screen UI widget with credit card form and native or cash pay options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pre-built UI widget representing a checkout screen and a standalone credit card form. It handles layout, form inputs, and validation while leaving transaction and payment processing logic to your own system.
use_when: You need a standard checkout screen UI quickly and plan to couple it with your own payment transaction API.
You want a reusable credit card input form component alongside native pay and cash payment options.
avoid_when: You require an all-in-one payment processing SDK that handles actual gateway communication rather than UI only.
Your project uses older Dart or Flutter versions below the specified minimum requirements.
strengths: Includes both a full checkout page and a standalone credit card form widget.
Provides built-in card validation and masking patterns.
weaknesses: UI only; requires manual integration with third-party transaction APIs.
Does not process payments or integrate natively with payment gateways out of the box.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. No complex native configuration needed since it is UI only.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need deep native Stripe payment integration rather than just a UI-only checkout screen.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are selling digital goods and subscriptions via official app store billing systems.
